preconditions.expression: isinstance(current_time, str) and len(current_time) == 5 and current_time[2] == ':'
preconditions.description: Input is a string formatted as HH:MM with a colon separator.
The hour and minute components consist only of digits.
The hour is between 0 and 23, and the minute is between 0 and 59.

postconditions.description: The return value is the minutes remaining until the next bus departure, calculated as the difference between the next scheduled bus time (rounded up to the next 15-minute interval starting from 06:00) and the current time plus 5 minutes walking time. If the current time is past the last bus (00:00), the result is 0.
The output is a non-negative integer representing minutes.
